newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - FTSE to go up to 4,695-4,720 region.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - FTSE to go up to 4,695-4,720 region.

text.p: The ingredients are in place for the FTSE 100 index to go up to 4,695, and posssibly to 4,720 on Tuesday, technical analysts said.
Market breadth had been about two-to-one in favour of advancing stocks on Monday and analysts expect this to be equalled, if not improved today.
With crude oil prices moving higher, oil stocks will make headway and bank shares as well as metals and transportation stocks should strengthen, they added.
By 0717 GMT, at the pre-market open the FTSE was indicated up 17.1 to 4,686.7.
